title: WorkstreamDispatchJobRecord
description: Closed v1 job record schema for the Workstream Dispatch protocol. One immutable JSON file per dispatched job at `.workstream/dispatch/<job-id>.json` inside the target workspace. The record is workspace-owned, create-only, and never modified or deleted by Arjim after creation (R19). Readers dispatch on the required integer `schema_version` before applying the closed schema; v1 allows the value 1. The record carries no outcome-note path: Arjim derives that path from `job_id` (R26, KTD11), so no agent-writable value decides which file a status answer opens. `additionalProperties: false` at every object level makes a reintroduced `outcome_note_path` a validation failure rather than a silently honoured field.

schema_version.description: Record contract version; readers dispatch on it before applying the closed schema. v1 allowed value: 1.

job_id.description: Unique job identifier (uuid4-shaped, RFC 4122 v4 lowercase hex with hyphens). Keys the Arjim-local binding, the Paseo label value `arjim.job=<job-id>`, `follows` references, and the record filename.

workstream_identity.description: The registered workstream identity at dispatch time (from the workspace marker). Used for unattributable-job detection (R31).

instruction.description: The operator-confirmed instruction text — prose intended for an agent, not a command line (R1). The exact bytes dispatched are byte-identical to the bytes whose digest was confirmed (R2). Stored as the sole sanctioned record of what was requested; never persisted elsewhere (R23).

provider.description: The pinned dispatch provider (KTD12). A record naming any other provider fails validation.

model.description: The operator-chosen model id (e.g. `opencode-go/mimo-v2.5`). Validated against the live CLI at draft time (U4), not enumerated in the schema.

mode.description: The operator-chosen mode string. Validated against the live CLI at draft time (U4), not enumerated in the schema.

thinking.description: The operator-chosen thinking option id. Validated per-model against the live CLI's thinkingOptionIds at draft time (U4, KTD12).

dispatch_posture.description: The confirmed dispatch posture tuple: provider, model, mode, and thinking (R27, R28). Provider is pinned (KTD12); model, mode, and thinking are per-dispatch operator choices.

follows.description: Optional identity of the predecessor job this step follows (R13). The relationship is recorded once at creation and never mutated.

actor.description: Bounded attribution: `operator-confirmed` when the operator supplied a confirmation from outside the process; `assistant-drafted` when Arjim initiated without an operator confirmation in hand (R3, AE12). Arjim never writes `operator-confirmed` for a confirmation it produced itself.

recorded_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the job record was written (R3).

confirmation_ref.description: The HMAC-SHA-256 digest of the confirmed instruction envelope (KTD8). Opaque to external readers; proves the operator saw this draft from this process.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the job was created (may equal recorded_at for immediate writes).
